content:
name: CI reliability diagnostics

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  development:
    name: Development fixture (${{ matrix.target }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { target: macos-arm64, runner: macos-15 }
          - { target: windows-arm64, runner: windows-11-arm }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      DESKTOP_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          architecture: arm64
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320
        with:
          cache: true
      - name: Set the macOS deployment target
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: echo 'MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=13.0' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Prepare the required desktop build
        run: pnpm desktop:build --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Install the browser used by development tests
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Record Electron distribution state before fixture preparation
        run: >-
          pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop exec node -e
          "const fs=require('node:fs');const p=require('node:path');const location=p.dirname(require.resolve('electron/package.json'));console.log(JSON.stringify({electronDistributionAlreadyPresent:fs.existsSync(p.join(location,'dist')),pathFileAlreadyPresent:fs.existsSync(p.join(location,'path.txt'))}));"
      - name: Run all existing development scenarios with the corrected fixture
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop test:dev
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        if: always()
        with:
          name: development-fixture-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: clients/desktop/app/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: error
